Questions

Frequently asked questions.

Do you work with resorts, hotels and boutique stays?

Yes. We work with resorts, boutique hotels, vacation stays, restaurants, bars and event venues that want to be found and booked directly.

What is a visibility index?

It compares how often guests see you against the properties you compete with. 100 is your fair share. Above 100 means you are getting more than your share of attention across Google, Maps and AI answers.

Do you help with direct bookings?

Yes. Every profile, page and post points guests to your own booking engine first, so more stays book direct instead of through third party sites.

Can you work with our booking system and brand standards?

Yes. We link to the booking or reservation system you already use and follow your brand standards, including flag requirements for branded hotels.

How do you track how AI recommends us?

Every week we ask AI assistants the kinds of questions travelers ask, like where to stay for a spa weekend or a family staycation, and report whether you are named and who is named instead.
